mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the clock to the pineal pathway was most worthwhile: the day-and-night comparison explains that melatonin usually rises at night and can be suppressed by light.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the nerve route to the gland felt least informative on its own; it showed the route but did not yet explain its role.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the nerve route to the pineal gland loops through the spinal cord and a nerve cluster in the neck.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although after the first decision each combination was the only one offered, so the choices felt largely directed.

continue.text: I would continue if the next chapter explored how these signals affect the body. This chapter made me curious, although its guided combinations offered little decision-making.
